## 48 teams. 4 pots. 16 picks. One trophy.

The **World Cup 2026 Fantasy Contest** is live now at **[sportsblock.app/contests/world-cup-2026](https://sportsblock.app/contests/world-cup-2026)**. Free to enter. **500 HIVE plus 10,000 MEDALS** in the pool. Entries lock at **23:59 UTC on 10 June 2026** — the night before Mexico kicks the whole thing off in the Estadio Azteca. Thanks to @fullcoverbetting for coming up with the format for this flagship event. 

That's roughly seven weeks to go so start planning. Course we don't want you to enter straight away. Injuries could play a crucial part in your selection process over the next couple of week. 

---

## The format

FIFA split 48 nations into 4 pots of 12. You pick **4 teams from each pot** — 16 teams total — and slap a **unique multiplier from 1 to 16** on each. Higher multiplier = you're more confident = more points when that team cooks.

Half fantasy, half conviction test. Yes, you can whack Argentina with a ×16 — but that means you've then only got a ×1 left for whoever you rate from Pot 4, and four of your picks are coming from the likes of Haiti, Curaçao, Cape Verde, Czechia. Those teams don't need to win the thing. They just need to nick a couple of points you weren't expecting.

Then you lodge a **tie-breaker guess**: how many goals the tournament will cough up in regulation time. Group stage plus knockouts. Extra time and pens don't count. Use it to separate yourself from the herd.

---

## How you score

Every match your picked teams play:

- **Win** → 3 points
- **Draw** → 1 point
- **Goal scored** → 1 point per goal

Multiply by the coefficient you gave that team. Then hand it in.

If you've got Brazil on a ×10 and they win 3-0, that's (3 + 3) × 10 = **60 points**.
If you've got Curaçao on a ×1 and they lose 4-0, that's zero. It happens.

---

## Knockout bonuses — this is where it gets interesting

Teams that make it past the group stage rack up cumulative bonuses. Every round reached pays on top of the match points. All multiplied by your coefficient, obviously.

- Round of 32 → **+2**
- Round of 16 → **+3**
- Quarter-final → **+4**
- Semi-final → **+5**
- Runner-up → **+6**
- Champion → **+7**

Pick the eventual winner with a ×16 multiplier and just their knockout bonuses are worth (2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 7) × 16 = **336 points**. On top of every match point they rack up along the way.

This is why your ×16 is a terrifying decision.

---

## The prizes

**500 HIVE + 10,000 MEDALS.** Split 60/25/15 across the top three:

| | MEDALS | HIVE |
|---|---|---|
| 🥇 1st | **6,000** | **300** |
| 🥈 2nd | 2,500 | 125 |
| 🥉 3rd | 1,500 | 75 |

Funded by Sportsblock. Free to enter. If the leaderboard ties, the tie-breaker prediction separates you.

---

## The deadline

**Entries close 23:59 UTC on 10 June 2026.** Roughly 24 hours before Mexico v whoever-wins-qualifying-Group-A in the opener.

Once the first whistle goes, picks are locked forever. No group-stage rebalance. No *"can I just swap Czechia for Ghana?"* No soft-close Thursday extension. The whole point of this contest is that you pick in April and live with it for five weeks.

So yes — it matters whether you do this today or leave it until 22:00 on 10 June with Wi-Fi that *"usually works."*

---

## How to enter

1. Sign in at **[sportsblock.app](https://sportsblock.app)** — Hive Keychain, HiveSigner, Google, whatever you've got
2. Head to **[/contests/world-cup-2026](https://sportsblock.app/contests/world-cup-2026)**
3. Pick your 16. Assign your multipliers. Lodge your tie-breaker.
4. Hit enter and forget about it until June

No stake. No rolling reselect. No paid premium tier. Just your 16 picks against the rest of Sportsblock for seven weeks of football.

---

**Pure sports. Real rewards. Pick 16.**

We can't deny that the world is changing at a pace that is quite difficult to follow and AI is taking a more and more important role. We see new things coming out, not on a monthly or yearly basis but on a daily basis. There are new models, new ways of working, new interfaces, new user experiences that AI makes possible. Nowadays, it's not just a question of whether AI can actually substitute jobs. It's already doing that at a large scale. Companies like Meta are laying off a lot of developers and substituting them with AI. AI is here to stay and AI is evolving. Probably most of us don't really realize at what speed this is happening. Some people still think that there are a lot of jobs that won't be affected by that but it's not the truth because AI doesn't come alone. There is so much development at the moment around robots that are actually powered by AI that will replace jobs like electrician or cleaning personnel. ## The AI Paradox The problem with that, and what I consider an AI paradox is that if people lose their jobs on all fronts, we will have on one side a whole sector of the population that has reduced income and on the other side things, products, and services that get cheaper and cheaper to purchase. But who is going to purchase all that if people don't have any money anymore? The economy lives from the consuming population and if this population can't consume anymore, what will happen? > This is something that Ford understood when he started mass producing cars. He made sure that all his employees were earning enough that they could afford to buy a car. It's a question of what system the future holds for us because the capitalist system that is relying on people getting wages for their work seems to be at a dead end. There is a second level because our government structures are also based on this concept of people having a salary and getting taxed on the salary. ## Crisis ahead ? So if employees don't have any money, if governments run out of money, we could think that the economy will come to a kind of standstill. I believe that this is already happening at the moment, that we have actually reduced consuming activity in all the different categories. What is worst for people is that they don't have the security that their income will last. Let's say that you are a software engineer and then you see that other people are laid off. It brings fear to you. What do you do? You start to reduce your expenses, you save because you don't have trust into the stability of your future employment. This means that less money is circulating. This is a circle that leads sooner or later to an economic negative growth or a crisis. So maybe we shouldn't put too much energy into fearing for our jobs. Maybe we should think about how our future could look like in the face of AI and robots taking over a lot of the workforce that exists now. This is the big question and I think that it's worth thinking about. ## Geopolitical challenges of the future One other thing that I would like to point out. If products are very cheap to produce and there are no more wages to be paid, there are other things that start to matter even more, like the things that the whole AI economy requires: - energy - soil - primary resources - water These four elements are the future strategic items that the governments are fighting for. Even if we are not aware of this directly at the moment, it is already happening when you see billionaires that try to go to space to figure out how they could use the resources from space. When China is thinking about building a huge power plant in the atmosphere that would collect the solar energy, when we see China and other countries fighting over our arable land in Africa, all such things contribute to the same picture. This is the future challenge that we all face. The struggle of power will be to have access to these key ingredients: water, energy, soil, and primary resources. How do you see it? How do you think the evolution will happen? Will there be a big crash, a big crisis or will it be an organic transition?

result.body: ## Hello, everyone. I welcome you to my blog. I think every human being loves luxury and will want to have a taste of it, and if given the opportunity, they might not resist it or even think twice before saying yes to it. When we live a life that is not in any form luxurious and see those living a luxurious lifestyle, we get to see a thousand reasons to choose and pursue luxury and all that is needed to make our lives luxurious ones. Sometimes I tend not to blame those who go the extra mile and will do anything just to see that the luxurious life they dream of is gotten or achieved. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcbfVaEDgAHTmNguhTgJPVPkM1qrnY19VCsZMR8aN2wBv/1776760476229.jpg) [Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/green-trees-on-cliff-I7oLRdM9YIw) Living a life that is not luxurious can be really stressful: having a house near a beach or close to the sea, having to travel by any means that you want or would like to travel by, and having all that you want and need is really something that every human being deserves, not situations where some have it all and some have little or even none at all. There are houses you will enter, and you will not want to go back to yours because it is not well furnished or well decorated like the one that you are in. A well-furnished house gives you that cozy feeling you cannot find anywhere else; it gives you comfort. You eat and sleep with both eyes closed as you are at peace, not the type where you are sleeping and it gets windy outside and you get scared that your roof is about to be blown off, and instead of enjoying the breeze or wind, you are forced to sit up in order to monitor everything and make sure there is nothing wrong. Having access to luxury will take all of that stress away and leave you enjoying peace and comfort. Saw a movie where a husband and a wife went on a vacation at a location where the hotel they lodged in is one that floats; the tides were high, and their room got detached from the others, and they woke up only to find themselves in the middle of the ocean with nowhere to go to, nowhere to turn to. A floating island, unless controlled, can cause one to find oneself in such a situation; you can just wake up and find yourself in a strange place. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYeiBCTTU71JH4YN5AZnAvpUMBbv8syxADsfCJYm58rRU/1776760476181.jpg) [Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-house-floating-in-the-air-surrounded-by-clouds-ODTi88liWEE) So will I accept living on an island that floats? My answer to this is no, as much as luxury is good and I enjoy and love it, but I will not want to do too much of it that might in any way pose danger to my life or that of loved ones that will be living with me. For me, I think living on an island is more than enough luxury; I don't need it to be floating before I confirm it is luxury. Some people, in the name of luxury, put themselves in positions that endanger their lives and those of loved ones. As much as luxury is good, I think it should have a limit or things that are off-limits; you can enjoy yourself and live a luxurious lifestyle without doing things that can cause harm or make something bad happening very easy.

![1776690215977.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/23zbAjh99tikNLQ6y38VqHYJycmjZA5hJi1v1LRVNPKDVQh34BsEv7ryMWqFJdj6h5Gs4.jpg)
Many blessings to all who are joining me again here on my blog. I hope you are all doing well wherever you are. Comrades, today I'm going to show you the drawing I made of the i212 IC24 card from the game Rising Star. As you can see, it's a nice light blue microphone. This is part of the series I'm doing this week of drawings of common microphones from the game; they're all really interesting. As always, you saw a preview of the finished drawing on the cover, but seeing the finished result isn't the fun part; it's seeing the creative process that led to that result. So, let's see step by step how I made the drawing from beginning to end. To start, I first drew the inner frame of the card, which looks like this: ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxfZTBich6x3QeTPC2QvM3AUP4gUd3S6VDESQhU1hka6QjCRvqq5LZ7TMkgP6.jpg) After finishing the frame, I drew the largest and longest part of the device, that is, its handle. And once I had drawn it, I moved on to drawing the top part above the handle. As you know, that's the part that would capture the sound in real life. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JhGpWc1yS6nDoC6BGn6RKUKRvJs2S8nirqb9KxP2fs5zjDvd2UzGmzEjx4X8zG9a.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo6S6U3zk96Q7eN7Co64tVQnhR3LuRmupKngCihp7zuQhi8rskT1u8f6QQtN6YGX5YE.jpg) In the details section, I drew some internal lines on the top to embellish the microphone and make it look better. These lines are also key when filling it in with color later, since each one will have a different color inside, and they help me paint the interior better. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo8ZVfHUn6UVjbP4mrvBXcZ3ZFxD5w7AQhu9idgY2vmteMSGyAGmr6bfYjPWziqtX95.jpg) Now comes the painting. As you can see, I started by painting the outer background first, then the inner frame, followed by the inner background, and finally the microphone. In the following screenshots, you can see the colors I used to fill each area. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EocAT6NrAmvVujrbnUvJfoo8kEjpGLGJ8ZqcRZh6sfXWsJbFAk9qbMXKznyvoHTPv3y.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoXkUxjUY8HqjKw7RBcpA8Jek6PvQpFsiezJuQZURfNooYQCq938MLhB3Kqc5qf2RkG.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eqqmd7Zwm6p5CsoK7ye6jb5oiPpVKhPNX5T2do562uTj34rQfvWmkCos8kDh8TpEf4v.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EqqkhQoYSMfNjdSvKVYbRNKALWxSPKVAwEdhdejhjDFUhasincKbtoRLrpXW3PaDWGy.jpg) And to finish and say goodbye for today, I'll show you the final result. See you in the next drawing. Blessings to all. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EqDbuWz7EdDHw8SyLC1SRPmKXLAQQTp8UkgQ21nwVSvoUb5SV3WgwHRy6idZ5VRhqQ4.jpg)

*Hello everyone, dear friends*

*Today I am ready to share with you again a new selection of my photos. Spring is a beautiful time of year. Every day you can find something interesting to take a photos. Over the past few years, I have grown so fond of taking photos that I can't imagine my life without it now. I like to capture moments of my life, moments of nature through photography. *** ![szablon cover — Odzyskano.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23wCA6d2Rqajcqp28Srz9PhMrbpFjUS9AD79VGAWVwsDTjjA6N8vSKbdXRtc5JCfmpNs7.jpg) ***
### Hello Black And White Community!
When I visit mountains, I often think about the processes that shape them. About the immense forces of nature that cause the massive rock masses that make up our planet's crust to rise. And very often, my mind can't comprehend it, though there are days when I can imagine it. Do you can imagine this?
> Kiedy odwiedzam góry, bardzo często myślę o procesach, które je kształtują. O ogromnych siłach natury, doprowadzających do wypiętrzenia się potężnych mas skalnych budujących skorupę naszej planety. I bardzo często moja głowa nie potrafi tego pojąć, choć są takie dni, kiedy jestem w stanie to sobie wyobrazić. A Wy jesteście?
![bnw.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23t6zsny35YcJ1HbmgsdTgAAdRFDg5nkzovenFhgYo3wVbLkhrMtYFFvyKGXCptT7SCYC.png) *** ![PSX_20260420_004923.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23uFPqVwbnuQ3jwZTruN9CMbreBHqMg29aztK4Zv4szgK7YanUbMJc8szmsGomHMz2vsr.jpg) ***
Once, these rocks rested peacefully, hidden deep beneath the surface, unobtrusive, unseen. Now, they attract crowds of tourists, like me, eager to witness their vastness and power. Many of these gawkers are likely unaware of the processes that led to the formation of all tall mountains.
> Niegdyś te skały spoczywały spokojnie, ukryte głęboko pod powierzchnią, nikomu nie zawadzały, nie szukały uwagi. Teraz przyciągają masę turystów, takich jak ja, chcących zobaczyć ich ogrom i potęgę. Wielu z tych gapiów jest zapewne nieświadomych procesów, które doprowadziły do powstania wszelkich wysokich gór.
*** ![PSX_20260420_005025.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23tH5j8Ypz5i2rJXDJos8EEszkTTB2JbBdKTRzWdUEeYNWYUVzK8KeyYfuX2QtddHTsAK.jpg) ***
It is estimated that the entire formation of the Tatra Mountains took several dozen million years, with the final stage of their uplift occurring 10–15 million years ago. The Alps and Himalayas also formed during a similar period. Although mountain formation ceased long ago, these mountains, like all others, are still being formed in some way.
> Szacuje się, że całkowity proces formowania Tatr trwał kilkadziesiąt milionów lat, a ostateczny moment ich wypiętrzania miał miejsce 10–15 milionów lat temu. W podobnym okresie formowały się również Alpy i Himalaje. Mimo że ruchy górotwórcze ustały dawno temu, to góry te, jak każde inne, wciąż w jakiś sposób są formowane.
*** ![PSX_20260420_005010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23vhz1dzJAGYaLu95hUaT6gF5iRTxhhVCQrQPWoBnNSm7ag9aMXCKbCs56U1yLTVaqM3K.jpg) ***
Wind and rainfall, and especially glaciers, are responsible for the continuous but very long-term transformation of mountains. Glaciers are responsible for the formation of many, if not most, mountain lakes. They are responsible, among others, for the formation of the lakes in the **Valley of Five *Spiš* Lakes**.
> Wiatr i opady deszczu, a w szczególności lodowce, odpowiadają za ciągłe, ale bardzo długotrwałe przekształcanie się gór. Lodowce odpowiadają za powstanie wielu, o ile nie większości, górskich jezior. Odpowiadają między innymi za powstanie jezior w **Dolinie Pięciu Stawów Spiskich**.
*** ![PSX_20260420_004958.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23x196MCM8mNFdnTrN6542c5jF3Tp15VGHZNHBAYScNPvTx6TV5mxycTnzcvKoKRG3Qwj.jpg) ***
In this never-ending transformation of the mountain landscape, photography plays a significant role. Perhaps over the course of a lifetime, the changes in the mountain landscape won't be significant enough for us to see clearly, and certainly not overnight. But someone in the distant future who sees photographs of the Tatra Mountains taken in our own time might say, "Wait, those mountains look completely different now."
> W tej niekończącej się transformacji górskiego krajobrazu fotografia odgrywa sporą rolę. Być może na przestrzeni całego ludzkiego życia zmiany w górskim krajobrazie nie będą na tyle znaczące, abyśmy mogli je wyraźnie zobaczyć, a już na pewno nie z dnia na dzień. Ale ktoś, kto w odległej przyszłości zobaczy zdjęcia Tatr wykonane w naszych czasach, być może powie: „Chwila, przecież te góry wyglądają teraz zupełnie inaczej”.
*** ![PSX_20260420_004946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/241tX7v9pN92CJChicf3KJQLo1Hcj5PYwdx8z8XiaC2MUVVYkfnDgwrFrMAJLoW4pkfzh.jpg) ***
I also think this applies to all other landscapes. The world is constantly changing, and what we consider everyday travel photography can prove to be of immense historical and documentary value for future generations.
> Myślę też, że tyczy się to wszelkich innych krajobrazów. Świat ciągle się zmienia i coś, co dla nas jest codzienną fotografią podróżniczą, dla przyszłych pokoleń może okazać się mieć ogromną wartość historyczną i dokumentalną.
*** ![PSX_20260420_004935.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23yTctro89SqyprfvZQyFF6pEdX9dhDmSnM4jGEDugFFPwPUE2NyL3R4FtGraZhHNXCp3.jpg) ***
I'd love to have access to photos of the formation of such mountains myself. I'm incredibly curious about what a time-lapse video of mountains forming would look like - photos taken every year, in the same place, at the same time. However, that's a rather abstract dream.
> Sam chciałbym mieć dostęp do zdjęć z formowania się takich gór. Niezmiernie pochłania mnie ciekawość, jak wyglądałby film poklatkowy przedstawiający formujące się góry — zdjęcia wykonane co roku, w tym samym miejscu, o tej samej porze. To jednak dość abstrakcyjne marzenie.
*** ![PSX_20260420_005036.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23wWvxPry4J2DNfm2umgcpxsytCUTSAT1NTymg5fKWCJFYJakFTM5RZm5L6YtCDPfsjHy.jpg) ***
With this post, I conclude my series on the hike to the Five Spiš Lakes Valley. A hike that taught me several very important things about planning mountain trips and how the mountains can surprise.
> Tym postem kończę serię poświęconą wędrówce do Doliny Pięciu Stawów Spiskich. Wędrówce, która uświadomiła mi kilka bardzo ważnych rzeczy dotyczących planowania górskich wypraw oraz tego, jak bardzo góry potrafią zaskoczyć.
![bnw.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23t6zsny35YcJ1HbmgsdTgAAdRFDg5nkzovenFhgYo3wVbLkhrMtYFFvyKGXCptT7SCYC.png)
***
*This is my entry for #monomad challenge by @brumest and @monochromes*
***
📸 Photographed using a Nikon Z6 with a Nikkor 24-70mm lens. 📸
Edited in Adobe Lightroom Mobile on tablet
Graphic elements was added in Adobe Photoshop

All photographs are my own work. The text was written by me and translated into English using a translator. Thank you for taking the time to visit and read my post.

Now I know what hemorrhoids feel like!

**Christmas and New Year with hemorrhoids**

People get sick at the most inconvenient times.

Nobody in his or her right mind wants to get sick, more so during a holiday season, such as Christmas and New Year.

Unfortunately, I suffered an acute hemorrhoidal crisis on Christmas Eve, and I struggled to drive to the local public hospital where I was treated in the emergency room.

I spent the night at the hospital, with medical staff keeping an eye on me, in case I suffered any complications.

**Hemorrhoids or something else?**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=\_DR8\_mJdBb0

The blood that I noticed on the toilet paper after having a poo made me very concerned.

I had noticed some blood a few times in the past, too, but I thought it was nothing serious, since bleeding was hardly noticeable, and I attributed it to some spicy food that I might have eaten.

This time, however, the bleeding was heavier, and I had to use quite a few toilet tissues to clean myself up down there.

That was when the suspicion that I had hemorrhoids crossed my mind.

What if it was something more serious, such as a perianal abscess or fistula, or even colon cancer though?

**Treatment of hemorrhoids at the hospital**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=97f2vKYJvLY

My doubt and ignorance about the actual cause of my rectal bleeding made me urge to the emergency room of the local hospital.

If it was only hemorrhoids, they could go away themselves, and healing would be assisted by medication, otherwise I would have to undergo a procedure called thrombectomy, or even a surgical operation, if the problem became worse.

After the surgeon visually inspected my anus, he also put his finger inside to make sure that it was hemorrhoids, and not something else.

I gave a urine sample and had my blood tested, so that doctors could identify the cause of bleeding more precisely, and determine the severity of my case.

**Treatment of hemorrhoids at home**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e-rdajRKl9g

After receiving treatment in the emergency room, I was given instructions and a prescription with medication to use at home.

More precisely, I had to drink plenty of water to keep myself properly hydrated.

In terms of the drugs prescribed to me, I had to take Daflon, according to the following dosage: 6 capsules per day for 5 days, then 4 capsules per day for another 5 days, and finally, 2 capsules per day for the last 30 days.

I reckon that doctors believed that my condition would improve, my hemorrhoids would be reduced and be no more swollen, and the symptoms would subside by then, so I wouldn't need to undergo a surgical procedure, whether minor or major.

Additionally, I had to apply Betadine on the prolapsed hemorrhoid after each bowel movement (poo), and a sterilized gauze with xylocaine gel on top of that.

**Unable to work because of hemorrhoids**

In addition to the discomfort that I experienced due to my hemorrhoids problem, I was literally unable to work.

Working as a translator and a writer involves regularly working long hours while seated on a chair.

Since I couldn't literally sit, I couldn't do any work.

Not to mention that leading a heavily sedentary lifestyle again in the future would result in my hemorrhoids coming back.

**Exercise, weight control, and hemorrhoids**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l2aIKP-aWWQ

Although I am satisfied with the treatment received from my attending physicians overall, I would like to point out that they should have placed a stronger emphasis on the role of exercise and weight control on addressing the problem of hemorrhoids, as a permanent, long-term solution, compared to drugs.

After searching online myself, I found out something that I had already suspected.

Getting some sort of mild, regular aerobic exercise, such as walking, can help a lot in dealing with constipation, which is a major cause of hemorrhoids; it can also help in having hemorrhoids healed faster.

Last but not least, exercise assists in maintaining a healthy weight, as opposed to having a big belly that applies pressure to internal organs, which can cause hemorrhoids, as a result.

(Versión en Español)

¡Ahora sé lo que se siente tener hemorroides!

**Navidad y Año Nuevo con hemorroides**

La gente se enferma en los momentos más inoportunos.

Nadie en su sano juicio quiere enfermarse, y menos aún durante las fiestas navideñas, como Navidad y Año Nuevo.

Desafortunadamente, sufrí una crisis hemorroidal aguda en Nochebuena y tuve dificultades para conducir hasta el hospital público local, donde me atendieron en urgencias.

Pasé la noche en el hospital, bajo la atenta mirada del personal médico, por si surgía alguna complicación.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=\_DR8\_mJdBb0

La sangre que noté en el papel higiénico después de defecar me preocupó mucho.

Ya había notado algo de sangre un par de veces antes, pero no le di importancia, ya que el sangrado era casi imperceptible, y lo atribuí a alguna comida picante.

Esta vez, sin embargo, el sangrado fue más abundante y tuve que usar bastante papel higiénico para limpiarme.

Fue entonces cuando sospeché que podría tener hemorroides.

¿Y si fuera algo más grave, como un absceso o fístula perianal, o incluso cáncer de colon?

**Tratamiento de las hemorroides en el hospital**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=97f2vKYJvLY

Mis dudas e ignorancia sobre la causa real de mi sangrado rectal me llevaron a acudir a urgencias del hospital local.

Si solo se trataba de hemorroides, desaparecerían por sí solas y la curación se vería favorecida por medicamentos; de lo contrario, tendría que someterme a una trombectomía, o incluso a una cirugía si el problema empeoraba.

Tras la inspección visual del ano, el cirujano introdujo un dedo para confirmar que se trataba de hemorroides y no de otra cosa.

Me hicieron una muestra de orina y un análisis de sangre para que los médicos pudieran identificar con mayor precisión la causa del sangrado y determinar la gravedad de mi caso.

**Tratamiento de las hemorroides en casa**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e-rdajRKl9g

Tras recibir tratamiento en urgencias, me dieron instrucciones y una receta con medicamentos para tomar en casa.

Más concretamente, debía beber mucha agua para mantenerme bien hidratado.

En cuanto a los medicamentos recetados, debía tomar Daflon según la siguiente dosis: 6 cápsulas al día durante 5 días, luego 4 cápsulas al día durante otros 5 días y, finalmente, 2 cápsulas al día durante los últimos 30 días.

Supongo que los médicos creían que mi estado mejoraría, que mis hemorroides se reducirían y dejarían de estar inflamadas, y que los síntomas desaparecerían para entonces, por lo que no necesitaría someterme a ninguna intervención quirúrgica, ni menor ni mayor.

Además, debía aplicar Betadine en la hemorroide prolapsada después de cada deposición y, encima, una gasa esterilizada con gel de xilocaína.

**Incapaz de trabajar debido a las hemorroides**

Además de las molestias que sufría por mis hemorroides, literalmente no podía trabajar.

Mi trabajo como traductora y escritora implica pasar largas horas sentada en una silla.

Como no podía sentarme, no podía trabajar.

Sin mencionar que volver a un estilo de vida tan sedentario en el futuro provocaría que me volvieran a salir las hemorroides.

**Ejercicio, control de peso y hemorroides**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l2aIKP-aWWQ

Aunque estoy satisfecho con el tratamiento recibido por mis médicos en general, quisiera señalar que deberían haber hecho mayor hincapié en el papel del ejercicio y el control del peso como solución permanente y a largo plazo para las hemorroides, en comparación con los medicamentos.

Tras investigar en internet, descubrí algo que ya sospechaba.

Realizar algún tipo de ejercicio aeróbico suave y regular, como caminar, puede ser de gran ayuda para combatir el estreñimiento, una de las principales causas de las hemorroides; además, puede acelerar su curación.

Por último, pero no menos importante, el ejercicio ayuda a mantener un peso saludable, a diferencia del exceso de peso que ejerce presión sobre los órganos internos, lo que puede provocar hemorroides.

(Esta publicación fue traducida del inglés al español con Google Translate)

Today I’m going to show you how to make the animated characters SpongeBob SquarePants and Patrick Star using moldable foam clay. Buenas Noches familia Diyhub, amantes de los trabajos manuales y artesanías, el día de hoy les enseñaré a realizar con foami moldeable (foam clay) a los personajes animados de Bob Esponja y Patricio Estrella. I'll tell you a little about these funny characters, the stars of the famous kids' TV show SpongeBob SquarePants, which started in 1999. They live amazing adventures under the sea, in Bikini Bottom, always accompanied by his best friend, Patrick Star. With their joy and bright colors, they entertain and visually cheer up the little ones at home. This cartoon was part of my childhood. It was really appealing because of its fun pastimes and wonderful adventures. As a token of affection, here I share with you some designs I made out of foam clay for the Hive community. I know it's not much, but it's my way of expressing myself through art.
Hablado un poco de estos divertidos personajes, protagonistas de la famosa serie infantil de televisión Bob Esponja que comenzó en 1999. Les cuento que viven increíbles aventuras bajo el mar, en Fondo de Bikini, siempre acompañado por su mejor amigo, Patricio Estrella. A continuación les mostraré paso a paso la realización de mi trabajo. Para empezar, mencionaré todos los materiales utilizados:

Materiales / Materials

  • Foami moldeable Negro / Black foam clay

One kg potatoes 

Half kg white chickpeas 

One big size onion 

Two green chillies 

One tomato 

One bowl yogurt

Salt 

Chat masala 

Lemon juice

This was mainly because I am a big fan when it comes to playing the Life is Strange series of games since I did it in some important moments of my life, but also because, ever since I started a [YouTube Gaming Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@doilupi), I never stopped thinking about how would it be to actually post only freshly released games. Along with turning the passion into a more expensive one, as it costs a little fortune to pre-order games in the 21st century, I am also not sure if it would actually be worth the financial efforts, since many bigger gaming channels get to play games way before they are released to the rest of the people. Hence why, those who are interested in some games have already watched gameplays way before you end up posting them on your own channel. Anyway, last night I started posting the gameplay videos from **Life is Strange: Reunion** on my YouTube Channel, and I thought I could also get back on making this kind of content on here too. Obviously, I am planning to keep these posts just once per week, as I don't want to be considered spam, although I post daily on my YT channel. But here we go with the first episode, as promised. https://youtu.be/tK49rsYk9J0?si=LIZZIlBdH7QwiZwM Why is this first video so important, you might wonder? Because it shows glimpses from all the other LIS games to make a little background of what **LIS: Reunion** is about for those who haven't played the previous games recently or at all. So, even if you are new in this game, you will understand the main parts of the story by simply watching the video from above, but I'd still recommend to play all the other games first so you make your own opinion on the overall story and don't judge the game's decisions based on just 10 minutes of intro which basically compress dozens of hours of gameplay from the first games. Oh, and let's not forget, my intro video might be different from yours. Or from anyone else who played this game. Because right after you get to meet Chloe and Max, you will need to make choices regarding Max's relationships with the other main characters of the game. Personally, I tried to be realistic and keep things simple yet interesting, but there can be a whole drama if you want! Anyway, I'll let you figure out what I'm talking about by checking the video out. 😁 - YouTube Channel: [Doi Lupi](https://www.youtube.com/@doilupi) - Life is Strange: Reunion Playlist: [click here](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLkvfHkWRLyE1mf7wdxd2HoP2KmLVNjqRM&si=RdADNvIGJcnyaij9) ![gabriela travels divider gaming.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/Eo8L1q1q6J3nWWpu8NRh7jbJkzcHsrSTzBzVoM4DUXdS2497yfcDaSySrzHN2sFApL2.png)
**Gabriela Travels** is a Curator for [Worldmappin](https://peakd.com/c/hive-163772) and [Hive Gaming](https://peakd.com/c/hive-140217/created) communities, but also the FOUNDER of "[Festival Mania](https://peakd.com/c/hive-151446/created)" who started this community from the passion of attending various festivals and with the purpose of encouraging more people to explore festivals all around the world and share their experiences. At the same time, **Gabriela** is an independent Graphic Design Freelancer since 2019 completing over 600+ orders in this time and collaborating with various businesses and people from all over the globe. Additionally, **Gabriela** has her own corner on the internet since 2017 where she writes various articles for her blog, the most popular being the travel ones (350+ articles written on this field), but also approaching other topics as well, like game and book reviews, lets plays, movie and series reviews, photography posts, cooking recipes and more, boosting the total number of articles written to 850+ blog posts. **Gabriela** is also a gamer since she was 11 years old and gaming remains one of her biggest passions along with traveling, owning a YouTube channel for each of the two.

지난 금요일 회사에 있는데 아내에게 온 전화를 못 받았습니다.
전화 온 사실을 30분 쯤 지나서 알게 되었는데 전화를 해보니 그땐 아내가 전화를 안받더라구요.
메시지를 보내도 답이 없고.. 그렇게 엇갈려서 무슨일이 있는지 몰랐는데 한시간 가량 후에 통화가 되서 아내가 하는 얘기는 접촉사고가 있었다는 겁니다.
아내 말로는 아내가 가해차량이고 피해차량은 작은 트럭이었답니다.
서로의 라이드미러가 모두 부서질 정도로 사고가 났었고, 혹시 몰라서 보험회사를 불렀고, 우리쪽이랑 상대방 보험회사에서 모두 왔답니다. 그리고 보험회사에만 알렸을 뿐인데 어느 사이엔가 견인차가 왔고, 수리를 해야 한다면서 단골 카센터가 있는지 있다면 그곳으로 가고 없다면 본인 카센터에 맡기라 했답니다. 아내는 어떻게 해야 몰라서 그때 저에게 전화를 했던 거였구요.

![IMG_4238.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbfyvoa8PYdopmZLqZUBKXHhHJp9UdA2A4mswJFRndQtZ/IMG_4238.png)
<출처 : https://pixabay.com/>

암튼 다친사람 없고, 사이드미러 말고는 크게 고장나지 않았고 근처라고 해서 차량을 보냈답니다.
그리고 차량도 무상으로 임대를 해주었다고 하더라구요.

큰 일이 아닌 것 같아서 퇴근하고 나서 확인하기로 했습니다.
퇴근하고 나서 혹시 몰라 아내라 병원에 가 보았고, 아내가 찍어 둔 사고 당시의 사진도 자세히 볼 수 있었습니다.
정말 사이드미러만 나갔더라구요. 상대방 차량도 그렇구요.

그렇게 주말이 지났고, 어제 제가 카센터에 전화를 해보았습니다.
보험료 인상되는 구간 안에서만 수리를 하려고 했었죠. 
그런데 담당자는 사이드미러만이 아니라 앞범퍼, 조수석 앞뒤 문짝, 휀다, 뒷범퍼까지 모두 손상이 되어서 모두 교체를 해야 한답니다.
사기꾼 냄새가 나서 우선 상대방 차량이 입고가 되면 연락을 주기로 했습니다.

오후에 상대방 차량이 입고가 되었고, 카센터가 아니라 상대방 보험회사에서 전화가 왔습니다.
어디까지 수리를 할 거냐구요.
카센터에서 저에게 얘기했던 방식으로 상대차주에게도 얘기했나 보더라구요.
서로 과실이 있다 보니 저희가 카센터에서 말하는 것처럼 전부 수리하면 상대차량도 전부 수리하겠다 하고, 사이드미러만 바꿀거면 본인들도 그렇게 하겠답니다.
당연히 사이드미러만 교체한다 했고, 카센터에 전화해서 그렇게 하기로 했습니다.
그리고 비용이 많이 나오지 않으니 보험이 아니라 서로 각자 일반수리로 하기로 했구요.

당연히(?) 카센터 담당의 목소리가 처음과 다릅니다.
틱틱 거리는 반응.

사이드미러 교체정도니 금방 될 거라 생각했는데 오늘까지 연락이 없네요.
우선 무상으로 차량을 임대해줬으니 아쉬울 것이 없어서 기다리고는 있는데 내일은 전화해서 점심시간에 찾으러 가야겠습니다.
근처라고 했는데 찾아보니 20km 는 되는 거리네요. ㅠ
